dimension_1_personas.name: Cooperative
dimension_1_personas.description: Helpful, wants to resolve issue quickly, provides accurate information.

typical_phrases: Of course, let me help you.

dimension_1_personas.name: Angry
dimension_1_personas.description: Hostile, aggressive, interrupts frequently, demands immediate resolution.

typical_phrases: Kaun ho tum? Kyun call kar rahe ho?

dimension_1_personas.name: Talkative
dimension_1_personas.description: Very conversational, gives long responses, may drift off-topic.

dimension_1_personas.name: Silent
dimension_1_personas.description: Gives minimal responses, may be shy or uncooperative.

dimension_1_personas.name: Suspicious
dimension_1_personas.description: Questions caller's identity, legitimacy, and motives.

dimension_1_personas.name: Busy
dimension_1_personas.description: In a hurry, interrupts to speed up call, wants quick resolution.

dimension_1_personas.name: Confused
dimension_1_personas.description: Has low comprehension, asks for clarification often.

dimension_1_personas.name: Receptionist
dimension_1_personas.description: Gatekeeper who screens calls, may be helpful but protective.

dimension_1_personas.name: Manager
dimension_1_personas.description: Decision-maker who is confident, direct, and asks strategic questions.

dimension_1_personas.name: Forgetful
dimension_1_personas.description: Has low memory retention, may forget information shared earlier.

dimension_1_personas.name: Impatient
dimension_1_personas.description: Low patience, interrupts frequently, wants instant answers.

dimension_1_personas.name: Elderly
dimension_1_personas.description: Speaks slowly and patiently, may have hearing issues, polite.

typical_phrases: Can you speak a little louder?

dimension_1_personas.name: Gatekeeper Defensive
dimension_1_personas.description: Protective of manager, challenges caller's authority and purpose.

typical_phrases: I cannot give out that information.

dimension_1_personas.name: Technical Minded
dimension_1_personas.description: Asks detailed, technical questions about systems and products.

typical_phrases: What's the specification of the equipment?
How does this integrate with our EMR?

dimension_1_personas.name: Bilingual Switcher
dimension_1_personas.description: Speaks Hinglish, switches frequently between English and Hindi mid-conversation.

typical_phrases: Hello, haan mera address same hai.
I am not sure, aap bataiye.
Theek hai, please check the records.

dimension_2_scenarios.name: Identity Verification
dimension_2_scenarios.description: Verify that the agent has called the correct hospital and decision-maker.

config.goal: Verify hospital and contact person identity
config.hospital_specific_context: Hospital name and location must be confirmed.

dimension_2_scenarios.name: Wrong Hospital
dimension_2_scenarios.description: Agent has reached the wrong hospital number, call needs graceful disconnection.

config.hospital_specific_context: This is a wrong number scenario.

dimension_2_scenarios.name: Address Verification
dimension_2_scenarios.description: Confirm the hospital's current address for procurement delivery.

dimension_2_scenarios.name: Address Change
dimension_2_scenarios.description: Hospital address has recently changed, agent must capture the new address.

config.hospital_specific_context: Hospital may have moved to a new building or wing.

dimension_2_scenarios.name: Procurement Unknown
dimension_2_scenarios.description: Caller does not know who handles procurement, agent must help identify.

config.hospital_specific_context: Hospital procurement departments can be complex.

dimension_2_scenarios.name: Procurement Name Collection
dimension_2_scenarios.description: Get the specific name and direct extension of the procurement person.

config.goal: Capture procurement contact name and extension
config.hospital_specific_context: Correct procurement person is key for order approval.

dimension_2_scenarios.name: Phone Collection
dimension_2_scenarios.description: Collect a valid phone number for the procurement contact.

config.hospital_specific_context: Phone may be mobile or landline.

dimension_2_scenarios.name: Email Collection
dimension_2_scenarios.description: Collect a valid email address for correspondence.

config.hospital_specific_context: Email used for sending invoices and order confirmations.

dimension_2_scenarios.name: Callback Request
dimension_2_scenarios.description: Caller requests a callback at a specific time or date.

config.hospital_specific_context: Often due to hospital staff being busy with patients.

dimension_2_scenarios.name: Voicemail
dimension_2_scenarios.description: Agent reaches voicemail, must leave a clear, professional message.

config.hospital_specific_context: Voicemail should be clear and concise.

dimension_2_scenarios.name: IVR
dimension_2_scenarios.description: Agent encounters an interactive voice response menu.

config.hospital_specific_context: Hospital IVR menus can be complex.

dimension_2_scenarios.name: Call Transfer
dimension_2_scenarios.description: Agent is transferred to another person, must re-orient.

config.hospital_specific_context: Transfer may be to procurement or administrative staff.

dimension_2_scenarios.name: Hostile Termination
dimension_2_scenarios.description: Caller is extremely angry and threatening, agent must de-escalate.

config.hospital_specific_context: Anger may stem from patient care issues or billing.

dimension_2_scenarios.name: Data Conflict
dimension_2_scenarios.description: Caller provides information that conflicts with existing records.

config.hospital_specific_context: Conflicts may arise from multiple locations or contact persons.

dimension_2_scenarios.name: Language Mirroring Test
dimension_2_scenarios.description: Simulate caller switching languages mid-call and using universal words.

config.goal: Force language switches and observe SUT behavior
success_criteria: SUT does NOT switch on universal words

dimension_2_scenarios.name: SSML Compliance Test
dimension_2_scenarios.description: Provide complex names and alphanumeric addresses to verify SSML formatting rules.

config.goal: Verify exact text output matches SSML constraints
success_criteria: Address text in SSML, numbers plain

dimension_2_scenarios.name: Refusal and Rephrase Test
dimension_2_scenarios.description: Simulate uncooperative caller to force SUT to rephrase, then explicitly refuse a field.

config.goal: Verify SUT accepts partial info without getting stuck
success_criteria: SUT accepts refusal and moves on

dimension_2_scenarios.name: Out of Scope Deflection
dimension_2_scenarios.description: Caller asks about pricing or support. Verify SUT deflection.

config.goal: Verify SUT deflects and re-asks in same turn
success_criteria: SUT uses exactly one sentence to deflect
SUT re-asks current step in same turn

dimension_3_languages.name: Hindi
dimension_3_languages.description: Pure Hindi, using Devanagari script and formal vocabulary.

common_phrases: Kya main address confirm kar sakta hoon?

dimension_3_languages.name: Hinglish
dimension_3_languages.description: Mixed Hindi-English, common in urban India.

example_openings: Hi, main kaun help kar sakta hoon?
Hello, main [agency] se bol raha hoon.

dimension_3_languages.name: Hindi Formal
dimension_3_languages.description: Hindi with formal pronouns and respectful tone.

example_openings: Kya main aap se baat kar sakta hoon?
common_phrases: Kya main address confirm kar sakta hoon?

dimension_3_languages.name: Hindi Casual
dimension_3_languages.description: Hindi with casual pronouns and informal speech.

dimension_3_languages.name: English to Hindi Switch
dimension_3_languages.description: Starts in English, switches to Hindi for comfort.

example_openings: Hello, this is [agency] calling... Haan, address confirm karna hai.
example_affirmations: Yes, that's correct... Haan, bilkul sahi hai.
example_negations: No, that's not right... Nahi, ye galat hai.
common_phrases: Can you confirm the address? Kya aap address confirm kar sakte hain?

dimension_3_languages.name: Hindi to English Switch
dimension_3_languages.description: Starts in Hindi, switches to English for technical terms.

example_openings: Namaste, main [agency] se bol raha hoon... We need to confirm the address.
common_phrases: Kya aap procurement department hai? Can you confirm?

dimension_3_languages.name: English Indian
dimension_3_languages.description: English spoken with a distinct Indian accent and phonetic variations.

dimension_4_speech_styles.name: Fast Speaker
dimension_4_speech_styles.description: Speaks quickly, may trail off or be less clear.

config.example_speech: Address is {{addr}} I think... yeah that's it.

dimension_4_speech_styles.name: Slow Speaker
dimension_4_speech_styles.description: Speaks deliberately and clearly, with occasional long pauses.

dimension_4_speech_styles.name: Normal Speaker
dimension_4_speech_styles.description: Standard speech patterns with good clarity.

dimension_4_speech_styles.name: Mumbling Speaker
dimension_4_speech_styles.description: Unclear articulation, frequent pauses, low clarity.

dimension_4_speech_styles.name: Elderly Speaker
dimension_4_speech_styles.description: Older person, slower speech, measured and polite.

dimension_4_speech_styles.name: Hesitant Speaker
dimension_4_speech_styles.description: Uncertain, many pauses and filler words.

dimension_4_speech_styles.name: Loud Speaker
dimension_4_speech_styles.description: Speaks at a high volume, may be aggressive or enthusiastic.

dimension_4_speech_styles.name: Soft Speaker
dimension_4_speech_styles.description: Quiet, whisper-like speech, may be hard to hear.

dimension_5_audio_environments.name: Quiet Office
dimension_5_audio_environments.description: Silent office with occasional keyboard and AC hum.

config.typical_situation: Administrative staff in a quiet office.

dimension_5_audio_environments.name: Hospital Reception
dimension_5_audio_environments.description: Busy reception area with phones, talking, and movement.

dimension_5_audio_environments.name: Traffic
dimension_5_audio_environments.description: Moving vehicle with traffic and engine sounds.

dimension_5_audio_environments.name: Cafeteria
dimension_5_audio_environments.description: Noisy dining area with multiple conversations and cutlery.

dimension_5_audio_environments.name: Construction
dimension_5_audio_environments.description: Active construction work with heavy machinery noise.

dimension_5_audio_environments.name: Home TV Background
dimension_5_audio_environments.description: TV playing in the background with occasional speech.

dimension_5_audio_environments.name: Busy Office
dimension_5_audio_environments.description: Open-plan office with multiple calls and conversations.

dimension_5_audio_environments.name: ICU Background
dimension_5_audio_environments.description: Hospital ICU with beeping monitors and ventilators.

dimension_5_audio_environments.name: Outdoor Public
dimension_5_audio_environments.description: Busy outdoor area with crowd noise and announcements.

dimension_6_interruptions.name: No Interruptions
dimension_6_interruptions.description: Patient listener who lets the agent complete thoughts.

dimension_6_interruptions.name: Constant Interruptions
dimension_6_interruptions.description: Very impatient, interruptions are nearly constant.

config.example_flow: Agent: 'I need your email' Customer: 'Why do you need my email?'

dimension_7_questions.name: Suspicious
dimension_7_questions.description: Distrusts the caller and questions legitimacy.

typical_questions: How did you get my number?
config.example_flow: Agent: 'I'm calling about procurement' Customer: 'How did you get this number?'

dimension_7_questions.name: Compliance Focused
dimension_7_questions.description: Asks about privacy, consent, and regulations.

typical_questions: What will you do with my data?
config.example_flow: Agent: 'email please' Customer: 'What's your privacy policy?'

dimension_7_questions.name: Pricing Focused
dimension_7_questions.description: Asks about costs and value proposition.

typical_questions: Do we need to buy something?
config.example_flow: Agent: 'I'm from supply company' Customer: 'How much is this going to cost?'

dimension_7_questions.name: Off Topic
dimension_7_questions.description: Asks questions unrelated to the call purpose.

config.example_flow: Agent: 'I need to confirm address' Customer: 'Are you from Mumbai?'

dimension_8_compliance.name: Asks Recording Policy
dimension_8_compliance.description: Customer expresses concern about call recording.

config.example_escalation: Customer hangs up if not satisfied with answer.

dimension_8_compliance.name: Asks Data Usage
dimension_8_compliance.description: Customer asks how their data will be used.

config.typical_statement: What will you do with my information?
config.required_response: Explain data usage clearly, mention GDPR/compliance

dimension_8_compliance.name: Asks Consent
dimension_8_compliance.description: Customer asks if they gave consent for the call.

config.typical_statement: Do you have my permission to call?
config.example_escalation: Customer demands removal from call list.

dimension_8_compliance.name: Requests Opt Out
dimension_8_compliance.description: Customer wants to stop future communications.

config.example_escalation: Customer complains to regulator if not handled properly.

dimension_8_compliance.name: Requests Do Not Call
dimension_8_compliance.description: Customer invokes the Do Not Call registry.

config.typical_statement: I'm on the Do Not Call list
config.required_response: Apologize, verify DNC status, remove immediately

dimension_8_compliance.name: Requests Callback
dimension_8_compliance.description: Customer wants to be called back at a specific time.

config.typical_statement: Can you call me back at {{time}}?
config.required_response: Schedule callback, confirm time and contact method
config.example_escalation: Customer gets annoyed if callback is missed.

dimension_9_telephony.name: Human Answer
dimension_9_telephony.description: A person picks up the call.

config.expected_agent_action: Leave detailed voicemail with callback info
config.example_interaction: Ring ring... [greeting] Please leave message after beep.
Press 1 for Sales, 2 for Support, 3 for Extensions.

dimension_9_telephony.name: Call Transfer
dimension_9_telephony.description: Call is transferred to another person.

config.expected_agent_action: Wait for new person, re-introduce self
config.example_interaction: Customer: 'Hold on, I'll transfer you to procurement.'

dimension_9_telephony.name: Call Drop
dimension_9_telephony.description: Connection is lost during the call.

config.expected_agent_action: Retry call, leave voicemail if no answer

dimension_9_telephony.name: Hold Music
dimension_9_telephony.description: Customer puts the agent on hold.

config.expected_agent_action: Wait patiently, be ready when transferred

dimension_9_telephony.name: Automated Recording
dimension_9_telephony.description: Agent interacts with an automated greeting system.

config.expected_agent_action: Wait for voice prompt, respond appropriately
config.example_interaction: System: 'Please state your reason for calling.' Agent: 'I need to speak to procurement.'

example_phrases: I don't have time for this

dimension_12_stt_difficulty.name: Moderate Noise
dimension_12_stt_difficulty.description: Some background noise and filler words.

dimension_12_stt_difficulty.name: Accent Heavy
dimension_12_stt_difficulty.description: Strong regional accent causing phonetic errors.

config.recovery_strategy: Agent may need to ask for spelling
Isolate speaker, ask for clear response
Ask to speak louder or repeat

dimension_12_stt_difficulty.name: Complex Names
dimension_12_stt_difficulty.description: Indian names and spelling challenge STT.
